public_body: Board Of Building Regulations And Standards
overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting its December 11, 2018 notice to the wrong website, failing to report its posting-location change, and posting an insufficiently detailed topic; the January 8 ratification did not cure it.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to properly post notice of its December 11, 2018 meeting, which was posted to a website other than its official posting location on file with the AG.
allegations.key_passage: This is not the webpage on file with our office as the Board’s official notice posting location.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the December 11, 2018 notice, listing only 'Discuss letter from MFBO', was not sufficiently detailed. Board argued January 8 discussion cured it.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board’s December 11 meeting notice was insufficiently detailed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed and voted on a matter not included in the December 11, 2018 notice, including sending a letter to the Town.
allegations.key_passage: Because we find that the Board’s December 11 meeting notice regarding the discussion of the MFBO letter was insufficiently detailed in the first instance, and therefore any discussion on that topic was held in violation of the Law, we do not find it necessary to separately analyze whether the ensuing discussion and vote arose out of the discussion of the MFBO letter

allegations.summary: Town alleged it was denied the opportunity to adequately represent itself at the meeting through Town counsel and asked that the record be reopened for Town counsel.
allegations.key_passage: We note that, other than in an executive session held under purpose one, the Open Meeting Law does not establish any right to participate in or be heard at meetings

allegations.summary: Town alleged it received late, insufficient direct notice from Board staff the day before the meeting that the MFBO letter would be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: We note again that, other than for an executive session held under purpose one, there is no obligation in the Law that the subject of an anticipated discussion be provided with direct notice.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Notify the AG's office within 14 days of the specific website to be used as the official notice posting location, and post all future notices to that website until notified otherwise.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
